player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci ñaari {num_rounds}-ronde Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Samay jëfandikoo lañu ngone jigeen ñaari ronde ñi ñu man a am.
Ci ñaari ronde, tontu ci: '[rock]', '[paper]', walla '[scissors]'.
Yaa ngone itam '[r]', '[p]', walla '[s]' niki bànqaas bu gaaw.

outcome.p0_wins: Jëfandikukat 0 moo ci gën a am ay jàll!
outcome.p1_wins: Jëfandikukat 1 moo jël li ëpp ci ay tukki!
